A [[human]] served as a '''private''' for the [[Galactic Empire]] in the [[Aldhani Garrison]] on the [[planet]] [[Aldhani]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="The Axe Forgets" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[private]] first appeared in "[[The Axe Forgets]]," the fifth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which was directed by [[Susanna White]]. [[Joel Morris]] portrayed the character and was credited as Private #1.<ref name="The Axe Forgets" />
